title: Elihu Speaks: God Speaks in Various Ways

questions.question: But now, hear my speech, O Job, and listen to all my what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:1 (ESV): "But now, hear my speech, O Job, and listen to all my words."

questions.question: My words declare the uprightness of my what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:3 (ESV): "My words declare the uprightness of my heart, and what my lips know they speak sincerely."

questions.question: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:4 (ESV): "The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life."

questions.question: Behold, I am toward God as you are; I too was pinched off from a piece of what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:6 (ESV): "Behold, I am toward God as you are; I too was pinched off from a piece of clay."

questions.question: Behold, no fear of me need terrify you; my pressure will not be heavy upon whom?
questions.explanation: Job 33:7 (ESV): "Behold, no fear of me need terrify you; my pressure will not be heavy upon you."

questions.question: You say, 'I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, and there is no iniquity in whom?'
questions.explanation: Job 33:9 (ESV): "You say, 'I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, and there is no iniquity in me.'"

questions.question: Why do you contend against him, saying, 'He will answer none of man's what?'
questions.explanation: Job 33:13 (ESV): "Why do you contend against him, saying, 'He will answer none of man's words'?"

questions.question: For God speaks in one way, and in two, though man does not what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:14 (ESV): "For God speaks in one way, and in two, though man does not perceive it."

questions.question: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, while they slumber on their what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:15 (ESV): "In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, while they slumber on their beds,"

questions.question: Then he opens the ears of men and terrifies them with what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:16 (ESV): "then he opens the ears of men and terrifies them with warnings,"

questions.question: He keeps back his soul from the pit, his life from perishing by the what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:18 (ESV): "he keeps back his soul from the pit, his life from perishing by the sword."

questions.question: Man is also rebuked with pain on his bed and with continual strife in his what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:19 (ESV): "Man is also rebuked with pain on his bed and with continual strife in his bones,"

questions.question: If there be for him an angel, a mediator, one of the thousand, to declare to man what is right for whom?
questions.explanation: Job 33:23 (ESV): "If there be for him an angel, a mediator, one of the thousand, to declare to man what is right for him,"

questions.question: Deliver him from going down into the pit; I have found a what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:24 (ESV): "and he is merciful to him, and says, 'Deliver him from going down into the pit; I have found a ransom;'"

questions.question: Let his flesh become fresh with youth; let him return to the days of his what?
questions.explanation: Job 33:25 (ESV): "let his flesh become fresh with youth; let him return to the days of his youthful vigor;"

key_verse_text: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
